note: The Gambia: nationals of the African Union's, the Commonwealth's, the EU's and EFTA's states and of the others listed enter without a visa for 90 days; US citizens get a 30-day visa on arrival; everyone else needs a visa from a Gambian mission (or on arrival at Banjul where there's none in their country, not modelled). The USD 20 security fee each way isn't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Tourism Board's list and Timatic.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of the Gambia
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries may enter Gambia without a visa for stays up to the duration below: 90 Days All African Union member states All Commonwealth of Nations member states All European Union member states All European Free Trade Association member states Albania Andorra Bosnia and Herzegovina Indonesia Monaco Montenegro North Macedonia San Marino Serbia Turkey United Arab Emirates United Kingdom Vatican City ... Citizens of United States can enter the country with a visa on arrival for maximum of 30 days.
